title: THIS RAVEN CAN SOUND LIKE A BARKING DOG
caption: Some ravens can imitate barking and other sounds. 🐦‍⬛ #Raven #BirdIntelligence #AnimalFacts #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: Did that raven just sound like a dog?
narration_timeline.scene: Open on the authentic raven mimicry clip

narration_timeline.text: Common ravens have a rich range of calls, and some can imitate noises they hear, including barking.
narration_timeline.scene: Keep mimicry/calling visuals synchronized with the explanation

narration_timeline.text: They solve problems, investigate objects, and interact in complex ways.
narration_timeline.scene: Switch to active raven behavior as intelligence is discussed

narration_timeline.text: A pair may exchange calls while another raven searches for food nearby.
Their intelligence helps them adapt to changing environments. Not every raven mimics sounds, and wild birds don't need tricks to be remarkable.
narration_timeline.scene: Use varied natural raven behavior rather than staged mimicry

narration_timeline.text: The payoff? That deep croak can belong to a bird capable of much more than one voice.
narration_timeline.scene: End on a strong raven call payoff
